description: 16-step sequencer with seven programmable rows per step, per-step probability and ratchets, ten traversal orders and a clock divider and multiplier

params.text: Sets the semitone for that step, 0 to 11, or 0 to 23 when the two-octave pitch range is chosen on the menu
Shifts that step by whole octaves, -2 to +2
Cycles that step through the eight step modes: Play, Mute, Skip, Accum Up, Accum Down, Pulse, Gated and Hold
Sets the gate length of that step as a fraction of one sequence period, 1% to 95%, with no effect while the module is in TRIG mode
Sets the voltage that step puts out on the first modulation output, 0 to 10 over whatever range the menu gives that output
Sets the voltage that step puts out on the second modulation output, 0 to 10 over whatever range the menu gives that output
Sets how many steps the active window holds, 1 to 16
Sets which physical step the active window starts at; the window wraps past step 16 back to step 1
Picks the traversal order: Pendulum, Backward, Forward, Random, Drunk, Ping-Pong, Odd/Even, Jump, Converge or Diverge
Switches the gate output between gates whose length follows each step's duration and fixed 10ms triggers
Divides or multiplies the incoming clock, from divide by 48 to multiply by 48, before swing is applied
Delays every other sequence tick, 0% to 60%, after the ratio has been applied
Slews the pitch output between steps, 0 to 2 seconds; gates, modulation and step selection are not delayed
Sets how many semitones an Accum Up or Accum Down step adds to or takes from its own stored offset, 0 to 24
Randomises all sixteen values of that row at once; double-click to set the row back to its default instead
Lowers every value of that row inside the active window by one step of that row's own grid, stopping at the row's limit
Raises every value of that row inside the active window by one step of that row's own grid, stopping at the row's limit
Left of centre this is the chance that step plays, 100% down to 0%; right of centre it is a ratchet count of 2 to 8, read only by the Pulse, Gated and Hold modes
Scales the chance of every step playing, 0% to 100%, multiplied with each step's own probability
Sets the range the per-step accumulator wraps through, 1 to 12 semitones either side of zero; at OFF it wraps through the full -12 to +12 semitones

inputs.text: The clock the sequencer runs on; a rising edge above 1V advances one sequence tick, subject to the ratio and swing
A rising edge above 1V returns to the first step of the active window, clears every step's accumulator and interrupts a held or ratcheted gate
A rising edge above 1V randomises all sixteen values of that row, whether or not they are inside the active window
Transposes the pitch output at a volt per octave, quantised to semitones and limited to four octaves either way

outputs.text: The pitch of the selected step: its semitone and octave, plus transpose, plus that step's accumulated offset, with the glide applied
A 10V gate or trigger for the selected step, its length set by that step's duration knob and the gate mode switch
One 10V gate per position of the active window, on a polyphonic cable whose first channel is the window's first position rather than physical step 1
A 10V, 10ms pulse when the traversal completes a cycle; Random never produces one, and Pendulum produces one at each turn
The first modulation lane's voltage for the selected step
The second modulation lane's voltage for the selected step

notes: nothing moves until a clock is patched; there is no internal tempo, and with the clock jack empty the gate, poly and end-of-cycle outputs stop while pitch and modulation hold.
Skip steps are bypassed without taking any time in Forward, Backward, Pendulum, Random and Drunk; in the other five orders they keep their place in the order and are played silently.
a ratio other than one to one needs the clock period measured first, so allow an edge or two after patching or changing the clock source.
the fractional multipliers of one and a half and two and a half re-anchor on every incoming edge and come out close to one to one and two to one; use the whole-number ones instead.
a failed probability test blocks the accumulation as well as the gate, and pitch and modulation update to the selected step either way.
menu: EOC on reset — off by default, makes the reset input produce an end-of-cycle pulse as well
Direction mode — picks the traversal order, the same setting as the knob on the panel
Jump stride — how many positions the Jump order moves each advance, from two to seven
Pitch range: 1 octave (0..11), 2 octaves (0..23) — sets what the pitch knobs cover, rescaling the values already entered
Range Mod 1 — sets the voltage range of the first modulation output, from ±10V down to 0V..1V
Range Mod 2 — sets the voltage range of the second modulation output, from ±10V down to 0V..1V
